query_analysis.original_query: We are looking to develop a more energy-efficient approach to extract ethanol from a 95% azeotropic mixture. Any suggestions on alternative distillation or hybrid methods?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Design an advanced, energy-efficient separation strategy for breaking the ethanol-water azeotrope with minimal thermal energy consumption using innovative distillation or hybrid separation techniques

communication_strategy.information_flow: Iterative design of energy-efficient separation techniques

clarification_questions: What is the current energy consumption of your existing distillation process?
Are there any specific constraints on equipment modification or replacement?
What temperature and pressure ranges are typical in your current separation process?
